lines.t: Before the dawn, before my breath, a plan of grace was laid
Love was present in the silence, long before the earth was made
Joy still shines through every shadow, mercy hears the weakest cry
Sorrow meets a broken heart and still hope rises high
Love that never lets go, joy that fills the soul
Peace that calms the raging sea, holy comfort covering me
Righteous fire against the night Gentle mercy, pure and bright
Truth that stands forever strong Home where every heart belongs
Chains are shattered by your power Falsehood loses at the door
What destroys the child you cherish Will not stand forevermore
For the lost and wounded, for the weary and afraid
Healing flows like living water in the shelter of your name
Sorrow is not absent here, neither is a cruel demand
Only holiness and mercy, only love that holds my hand
Love that never lets go, joy that fills the soul
Peace that calms the raging sea, holy comfort covering me
Righteous fire against the night, gentle mercy, pure and bright
Truth that stands forever strong, home where every heart belongs
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
